title: Representative normalization of lisse pullback realization
statement: For a normalized realization family at the source and target of an arbitrary scheme morphism [def-real-lisse-realization-data], define a normalized pullback comparison as follows. Use the ordinary integral module pullback, its specified adjunction, and its termwise lift to complexes [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction]. The ordinary integral/rational scalar square sends the integral adjunction unit to the ordinary rational adjunction unit, with scalar factor one. Its derived comparison is fixed on every complex by these ordinary maps and their universal derived counits. The derived rational pullback on a finite locally free sheaf in degree zero identifies with its ordinary pullback by that same counit and the single-complex comparison. On integral constructible objects, the realization comparison is the integral realization, inverse of the specified ordinary-to-completed pullback comparison [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback], the derived scalar square, and inverse target realization. Its map in degree-zero homology is the lisse pullback comparison; the identification of a degree-zero derived object with its homology is required to induce the identity on degree-zero homology.
